notes: Modified cash basis village, fiscal year ended 9/30/2025; trimmed PDF has 15 pages. Governmental lines from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (p6-8); business-type from Exhibit IV Total Proprietary Funds column (p9-10). Governmental roll-forward: 40,570.34 + 240,137.78 - 256,630.28 + 52,000 - 17,000 = 59,077.84 (governmental transfers in 52,000 = 35,000 General + 17,000 Street; of which 17,000 from General and 35,000 from utility funds). Business-type: 430,996.26 + 1,021,734.64 - 888,956.05 - 35,000 = 528,774.85. No single business-type receipts total printed: operating total 651,574.28 + nonoperating 370,160.36 added. Governmental disbursements are listed by object only, so function general government used (review). Detail: governmental General/Street/Building from the combining cash receipts/disbursements schedules (pp11-12; right-hand columns for Bandstand, Playground and totals are cut off on those pages, and budget columns are not visible except total budgeted disbursements: General 151,700.00, Street 153,591.25, Building 12,900.00), so budget_final is null. Bandstand and Playground Equipment lines are from Exhibit III 'Other Governmental Fund' column (donations 45,500 and improvements 46,421.53 for Bandstand, interest 0.28 for Playground), assigned per fund totals on p15. Proprietary detail for Light, Water and Sewer from Exhibit IV (p9), which is more complete than the combining budget schedule (p13-14, Sewer column cut off); Water revenue detail total 490,539.34 (p15) = operating 120,378.98 + nonoperating 370,160.36. Transfers cross-check: General in 35,000 and Street in 17,000 match General out 17,000 plus Light out 100,000 less Water in 65,000; no hidden transfers found. Statement of Activities p2-5 reviewed; its general receipts do not add new tax breakdowns. Read pages 1-15 of 15
